method: Single focused independent affected review using code-review Standards and Spec axes; reuse previous full technical and handoff reviews.

standards.basis: Append-only owned documentation; immutable prior evidence retained; exact user response and candidate provenance; honest scope, timestamps, uncertainty, and authority. Applicable code-review smell baseline considered; no actionable new finding.

spec.basis: PI-DURIO-V1-SPEC-r1 A2/A3/A4 and T22/#32 are satisfied by applicable technical acceptance for #11–31 plus the direct user statement 已试用当前版本，日用接受，收尾. No additional duration, paid trial, questionnaire or environment-detail gate is imposed.

referenceIdentity.method: SHA-256 and byte length for every path/bytes/sha256 entry using absolute or docs-relative file paths in four new JSON documents; duplicate entries counted. No recursive inventory scan.

originalsPreserved.method: Recorded hashes plus parent/candidate Git blob equality.

selectedTrialObjectMetadata.fields: Artifact candidate/environment, offline configuration, closed status/observation/cleanup/lifecycle; compared with content-addressed objects without exporting prompt or answer text.

limitations: Two saved offline fixture runs are supplementary candidate-binding evidence; they do not prove physical provider requests, real inference or unobserved user tasks.
Direct user statement attests actual use and explicitly accepts daily use. Exact message sent time, human trial duration, Terminal application/profile/font/dimensions remain UNKNOWN or NOT_EXPOSED.
Historical FAIL, UNKNOWN, NOT RUN, npm 11.19.1 installation-path limitations, and native scenario limits remain unchanged. No new whole-suite PASS is claimed.
Issue OPEN at producer readback is a historical remote observation. Acceptance does not assert issue closure, main merge or release; coordinator owns authorized closeout.
Requested model gpt-6-astra/xhigh; actual backend NOT_ATTESTED.

reviewerDiagnostics.explanation: Output directory already contained a coordinator-owned publication subdirectory; no review files were written. Retried with per-target nonexistence assertions and preserved that sibling directory. Not a product or candidate failure.
